key_safety.text: Most common adverse reactions (incidence >=20%) were fatigue (41%), constipation (34%), edema (30%) and myalgia (29%). Most serious adverse reactions were hepatotoxicity, interstitial lung disease, muscular toxicity (CPK elevation and severe myalgia), and bradycardia. Fatal adverse reactions occurred in 2.8% of the 253 patients.
